About Cafe Crave

Since 2020, Cafe Crave has served Plumstead a menu built around the food people actually crave — loaded breakfasts, thick house-made burger patties, hand-cut steaks and platters made for sharing. Every dish, from the espresso bar to the grill, is halaal certified.

Come in for a quiet coffee and a slice of cheesecake, or bring the whole table for a family platter. Either way, comfort food is the whole point.

Halaal certified Established 2020 120 Main Road, Plumstead
